label: Late original-phase positions (t>=5), boosted after c/u/v/w or on input s
explanation: Fires almost only during the original (input) phase at late positions: 99.7% of activation mass is in the original phase, none in the copy phase, nothing at t<=3, peak at t=6-7, and it is concentrated in the last ~3 inputs before <DEL> (to_go 0-2). (phase==0)&(t>=5) covers 98% of mass, but only ~9% of those steps are active, so position alone is a necessary condition, not a sufficient one. Within that window, firing is much more likely when the input token is s (5x lift, top examples peak on s) or the previous input is c/u/v/w (~4x lift), and when the sequence starts with h or z. Adding these token conditions raises precision to ~0.29 but drops mass recall to ~0.55. The remaining dependence looks like a graded function of the token history that no simple predicate captures. It is basically silent at the <DEL> step and on every copy step.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig1=z (+3.39), prev_tok=v (+3.32), prev_tok=u (+3.18), prev_tok=c (+3.14), orig2=z (+2.90), orig0=z (+2.71). Lower it: prev3_tok=- (-9.40), orig_idx=-1 (-6.60), phase=2 (-5.19), t=3 (-5.00).
